content.title: Access Advanced Reports according to subscription plan
content.description: An account holder uses the dashboard's Advanced Reports feature when the account is on the `pro` plan, in which case the section is visible, its content loads, and direct API access succeeds, while `free` accounts are denied both dashboard and direct-endpoint access and are shown an upgrade prompt instead of report content.
content.summary: Use Advanced Reports with plan-based access.
content.value: Delivers premium functionality to entitled users while enforcing subscription-based access control in both UI and API surfaces.
criteria: Advanced Reports is a Pro-only feature: `pro` accounts can access it and `free` accounts cannot
when the account plan is `pro`, the Advanced Reports section is visible on the dashboard and its content loads successfully
direct requests to the Pro-only API while the plan is `pro` return success (200) with feature content
when the account plan is `free`, the dashboard replaces Advanced Reports with an upgrade prompt instead of feature content
direct requests to the Pro-only API while the plan is `free` return rejected (403) rather than feature content
